description: This Java test class defines unit tests for the AclEntryModified class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It includes tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructors with invalid parameters.

classes.name: AclEntryModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AclEntryModified, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validations.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that AclEntryModified instances are immutable and that related JsonObject and AclEntry objects are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to test the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for AclEntryModified.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating an AclEntryModified instance with a null String ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an AclEntryModified instance with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAcl
methods.description: Tests that creating an AclEntryModified instance with a null AclEntry throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation of the AclEntryModified instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that an AclEntryModified instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.
